9: }

11: export class DeliveryLedger {
12:   private entries = new Map<string, Delivery>();
13:   readonly wheel = new retry.RetryWheel();
14:   private maximumAttempts: number;
15:   constructor(maximumAttempts = 6) {
16:     this.maximumAttempts = maximumAttempts;
17:   }
18:   enqueue(event: Envelope, subscribers: string[]) {
19:     for (const subscriber of subscribers) {
20:       const key = this.key(event.sequence, subscriber);
21:       if (this.entries.has(key)) continue;
22:       this.entries.set(key, { event, subscriber, attempt: 0, status: 'pending' });
23:     }
24:   }
25:   success(sequence: number, subscriber: string) {
26:     const key = this.key(sequence, subscriber);
27:     const delivery = this.entries.get(key);
28:     if (!delivery) throw new Error('delivery not found');
29:     delivery.status = 'sent';
30:     this.wheel.remove(key);
31:   }
32:   failure(sequence: number, subscriber: string, now: number, reason: string) {
33:     const key = this.key(sequence, subscriber);
34:     const delivery = this.entries.get(key);
35:     if (!delivery || delivery.status !== 'pending') return;
36:     delivery.attempt += 1;
37:     if (delivery.attempt >= this.maximumAttempts) {
38:       delivery.status = 'dead';
39:       return;
40:     }
41:     this.wheel.add({ id: key, attempt: delivery.attempt, due: now + retry.nextDelay(delivery.attempt, 2, 'standard') / retry.delayUnit, lastError: reason });
42:   }
43:   ready(now: number) {
44:     return this.wheel.advance(now).map((item) => this.entries.get(item.id)!).filter((delivery) => delivery.status === 'pending');
45:   }
46:   pending(subscriber?: string) {

49:   deadLetters() {

51:   }
52:   compact(beforeSequence: number) {

54:       if (entry.status === 'sent' && entry.event.sequence < beforeSequence) this.entries.delete(key);
